svg.text: Zhengximen tuned against the reference board

g.text: 1 · "It should have textures" was a mesh problem, not a material one
The master material and all eight instances were correct, and the validator had confirmed every texture parameter was bound.
The meshes were the problem: every exported GLB carried only POSITION and COLOR_0.
BEFORE — untexturable
POSITION, COLOR_0 — no TEXCOORD_0 on any of the 9 GLBs
The generator computes UVs, then writes face_colors, which replaces the texture visual
AFTER — textured
POSITION, TEXCOORD_0 on all 9 GLBs
TextureVisuals(uv=...) carried through both export paths, asserted in the driver
2 · The hollow timber wall was three defects, not one
0.12 m through-slot
each bay was its own panel, w = xb − xa − .12, so a slot ran between every pair
No end walls at all
the loop covered only front and rear — the two ends were open, 1080 of 1100 rays straight through
2.4 m above the gate
doors stopped at 3.22 m under a vault springing at 3.40 and topping at 5.65
Fix: one continuous closed wall per side on all four faces; end walls run past the front/rear faces so corners close by overlap.
Verified by ray-casting, not by eye — a bounding box cannot see this defect, because the broken version still had panels.
wall, 8 faces
4840 open
gateway
65 open
door-to-arch seam
242 open
3 · Fitting the door to the arc took three attempts
1 · Plain boxes
A rectangular door under a taller
vault leaves a 2.4 m opening
above the gate. Background
visible straight through it.
242 of 450 seam rays open
2 · Horizontal slices
Closes the opening, but every
step is a chord of the circle.
The leaf sits ~1.7 cm inside the
arc where it turns vertical.
14 of 450 seam rays open
3 · Sampled strip
The leaf's top edge is the arc,
built to a slightly larger radius
so it always overlaps; the excess
hides inside the arch ring.
0 of 450 seam rays open
Two things that only showed up in a straight-on view
An angled view cannot tell a gap from the shadowed inside of a barrel vault — both look like a dark band. Hence arch-front in Scripts/RenderZhengximenPreviews.py.
The wall's own opening was a staircase.
46 slices gave 17 cm steps; once the door filled the arch, that became the visible boundary. LOD0 now uses 400.
The barrel joints scalloped the edge.
3.5 cm vault tubes sat at the arch radius, so their tips were the silhouette. Now flush. Ring 34 → 96 segments.
Still open — native visual capture
Reimported and revalidated in UE (0 errors / 0 warnings, 218,328 tris, 7 HISMs), but a render needs an open editor with a live RHI.
